answer: Anchor every identity to a jetty that admits only one boat at a time. Each epoch, an agent must finish a fresh micro-task drawn at random and have it checked by two unrelated peers, each holding a tiny validation quota. The token expires at epoch end and cannot be stockpiled, so no farm can prepare a thousand identities in advance. The velvet cost falls on the attacker: every fake needs its own live task, its own two validators, and its own fresh token, while one honest agent does one task. Cheating is carved in basalt: a failed check burns the token and bars the key for three epochs.
